item.title: Kuwait alleges that Iran attacked an island hosting a China-funded port before Trump's Beijing trip
item.description: Kuwait has accused Iran of sending an armed Revolutionary Guard team to launch a failed attack on an island in the Middle East nation

item.title: ICC unseals arrest warrant for a prominent Philippine senator over drug war killings under Duterte
item.description: The International Criminal Court has unsealed an arrest warrant for a prominent Philippine senator linked to the deadly “war on drugs” overseen by ex-President Rodrigo Duterte, which allegedly involved the extrajudicial killings of suspects

item.title: Israeli lawmakers set up a special tribunal and allow for death penalty for Hamas-led 2023 attackers
item.description: Israeli lawmakers have approved a bill setting up a special tribunal that would try and have the authority to sentence to death Palestinians convicted of taking part in the 2023 Hamas-led attack that triggered the war in Gaza

item.title: Hegseth again looks to punish Democratic Sen. Mark Kelly over military comments
item.description: Hegseth said the Pentagon will review if Sen. Mark Kelly disclosed classified info in raising concerns about the strain the Iran war has placed on weapons stockpiles.

item.title: Inflation jumps to its highest level in three years
item.description: The Iran war has ratcheted up prices for gasoline, airfares and other expenses.
